presets.name: Safety -1 dBTP
presets.description: Catches overs and nothing else; nothing goes past -1 dB true peak.

presets.name: Transparent
presets.description: A little louder, with the longest look ahead and a smooth release.

presets.name: Streaming master
presets.description: Moderately louder, under -1 dB true peak, as streaming services ask.

presets.name: Loud master
presets.description: Pushed hard for loudness; listen for pumping and distortion.

presets.name: Maximise -1 dBTP
presets.description: Maximise mode: Gain sets the limiting, the Ceiling only the output level.

presets.name: Mid-side master
presets.description: Limits the mid and the side apart, keeping the centre's level.

presets.name: Dual mono
presets.description: Each channel on its own: wider-sounding, but the image can shift on peaks.

presets.name: Gentle bus
presets.description: Rounds off a group's peaks with a slow, fixed release.

presets.name: Drum bus peaks
presets.description: Shaves the tallest drum peaks fast, for headroom.

presets.name: Clip control
presets.description: Very fast, almost clipping: hard transients turned into loudness.

presets.name: Vocal peaks
presets.description: Catches a vocal's loudest moments after the compressor.

presets.name: Bass peaks
presets.description: Holds a bass's peaks with a release long enough not to distort the lows.
